title: Hyderabad: 4 inter-state drug peddlers held, 21kg ganja seized
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: Hyderabad Police arrested 4 accused in connection with ganja.
Police seized 21 kilograms of Ganja during the operation, officials said.
The incident came to light on Saturday.
